title: Final pressure (part 1)
description: Essential: Correct final pressure for part (1) after temperature change, approximately 0.94 × 10⁵ Pa.

title: Temperature conversion
description: Important: Converts Celsius temperatures to Kelvin for use in the ideal gas law.

title: Isochoric process application
description: Important: Applies the ideal gas law for constant volume (p₁/T₁ = p₂/T₂) to solve part (1).

title: Final number of pumps
description: Essential: Correct final answer for part (2), rounded up to 9 pumps.

title: Boyle's Law application
description: Important: Applies Boyle's Law (pV = constant) to relate pressure and volume changes per pump stroke.

title: Volume per pump stroke
description: Important: Correctly calculates the volume of gas added per pump stroke as S × l.

title: Rounding up logic
description: Optional: Explicitly states that fractional pump results must be rounded up to the next integer.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Uses Celsius directly in gas law, or fails to convert pressure/volume units consistently.

title: Pressure threshold confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses initial pressure (p₁) instead of final outdoor pressure from part (1) as the starting point for part (2).
